1.name: .NET Software Developer
1.description: Hi! I'm Max, a software developer specializing in .NET and business management systems. I have professional experience with C#, VB .NET, WinForms, MySQL, and SAP Crystal Reports, as well as web solutions using ASP.NET, Razor, Entity Framework, and SQL Server. I also study Sound Engineering, combining programming, acoustics, and signal processing.
1.jobSearch: I am actively seeking opportunities as a .NET developer.

2.name: Secondary School Mathematics and Physics Teacher
2.description: Hi! I'm Maxi, an educator with university-level teaching experience in Physics and Programming, as well as experience teaching secondary school students. I worked as a teaching assistant at UNTREF and UTN, contributing to lesson planning, exercise development, student assessment, and academic support. My background in Sound Engineering and Programming allows me to combine mathematics, physics, and technological tools to make complex concepts easier to understand.
2.jobSearch: I'm seeking teaching opportunities in Mathematics, Physics, and related subjects, particularly at the high school level.

junior-software-developer-halley.description: Development and maintenance of .NET business applications for service stations and retailers.
highlights: Joined as Junior 1 and earned an internal promotion to Junior 2, taking on greater autonomy and responsibility.
Led and independently implemented the redesign and refactoring of the point-of-sale system, modularizing a complex WinForms form into reusable components.
Centralized SAP Crystal Reports invocation and implemented reusable components for execution, parameterization, and sorting.
Optimized transactional stock and traceability processes on MySQL; reduced queries from 66 to 37 in one measured workflow.
Developed supply management for purchase, sale, and return operations using stored procedures and concurrency control.
Refactored error handling by migrating 637 calls across approximately 250 files to a centralized API.
